title: ID0453770-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / PN 170001129] Blackscreen problem
description:
Reported behaviour: There is Black screen problem
Solution:
From the information given by your side, I can see that you need to change the HMI. I will send you all the necessary references for the specific HMI required for this charger:
Adaptation 8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6
Controlp. RAFI middle segm. contactl. CCR 8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8
Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments
with AC cutout 8EM5902-1AA00-6AA0
If you notice anything else that can be improved or adjusted on your side to ensure that the cable holding system works as it should, please feel free to make those changes.
